notes: Background: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) with integrated in-app assistant and search. Heavy EU customer base, MTL and EU latency targets.
Why Redwood: performance predictability + unified API across hosted/dedicated; they want single control-plane for rollout and failover.
Timeline to date: started with Hosted API trial (Jan demo) -> positive latency/cost signals -> exploring Dedicated for predictable SLAs and data isolation.
POC ask: Dedicated reserved pool for 3 weeks, canary rollout to 5% traffic, automatic fallback to hosted model variant if latency or errors exceed thresholds.
Workload profile: chat assistant + embeddings for search; expected concurrency ~60-120 chats/minute; avg prompt length ~120 tokens; expected peak tokens/min ~45k.
Latency/throughput targets: p50 chat < 120ms, p95 < 350ms (EU + NA), tail latency critical for user experience; target 1k reqs/min after GA.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market — looking for net ARR impact; target blended unit cost < $0.0009/token for chat-embedding mix. Asked for Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + quant profiles).
Model preferences: prefer open Llama-derivative family variants for cost control; want automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant on overload.
Routing requirements: region-aware routing (primary: us-east-1, secondary: eu-west-1), model-variant fallback, and capacity-tier fallback (dedicated -> hosted API) with circuit-breaker thresholds.
Security checklist: SOC2 provided; customer asked for ISO27001 evidence (pending), SSO/SAML integration required, KMS for keys and audit-log retention 3 years.
Quotes: CTO Alex Reed — 'Need canary and rollback to be rehearsed; if the fallback path isn't seamless, product adoption stalls.'
Recent interactions: demo of Dedicated control plane (2026-01-12), pricing & committed capacity call (2026-01-20), security questionnaire submitted (2026-02-02).

POC details: Dedicated POC env requested (2x A100 equivalent GPUs), canary config: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over two weeks with automated SLA checks and rollback thresholds; include tracing hooks + token-level cost metrics.
SE notes: will provision VPC peering + customer-managed subnet; need confirmed IP allowlist and NAT config. Diego to run initial canary plan wk of 2026-02-15.

Rollback plan (agreed outline): detect anomalies (error rate > 1.5% OR p95 increase > 2x baseline) -> switch routing to hosted verified variant -> validate user-level sanity checks -> rollback Dedicated changes and open ticket RDW-3567 for root cause.
Region failover plan: active-primary us-east-1, passive eu-west-1. Failover trigger: region outage or sustained p95 degradation for 10m. Warm warmup KV-cache policy to avoid cold-start hit.
Docs shared: pricing deck v3, security FAQ, sample canary runbook (drive links attached).
Open legal ask: data residency clause for EU customer records — legal team reviewing sample SLA language.
Next tactical: run canary with Synthetic traffic + real traffic slice, confirm GPU sizing after first 48h metrics, reconvene pricing negotiation once POC shows 2-week stability.
Win criteria: meet latency SLOs, demonstrate failover without data loss, meet target unit cost with Optimize suggestions, security acceptance (ISO evidence).
